one_liner: A sliding-ice puzzle: a penguin slides until it hits something; 24 hand-designed levels with keys, doors, crumbling tiles and a 3-star move target.
why_this_opportunity: Logic Puzzle Levels offers feeling clever - the moment the slide you had missed becomes obvious. Research (capability-screen): Logic Puzzle Levels: a shape in the capability catalog, screened against crazygames, gamedistribution, gamemonetize, gamevui, poki, y8, yandex at 0.77, with observed market presence on poki. The opportunity rests on claim-fd23eeef70 and cites claim-12e9f11a8d, claim-55ff2909f5, claim-73f7084dbe, claim-8124a91873, claim-b5277fb850, claim-cdf943b10d, claim-d179e1fc07. Poki is primary (audience regions br, de, fr, gb, id, us; supports rewarded placements).

platform_set.rationale: Secondary: CrazyGames is compatible from the same build; not required to ship.
Secondary: Yandex Games is compatible from the same build; not required to ship.
Primary: best audience fit among compatible candidates (audience regions br, de, fr, gb, id, us; supports rewarded placements); the title is not shippable without it.

audience.player_description: A casual player on phone or desktop who wants to be playing within seconds, in sessions of about 5 minutes.

monetization.rationale: Being stuck is the rewarded moment (a hint or one revealed cell); interstitials between levels.

mvp: Core loop: read the level, plan the moves, solve it, advance to a harder level that adds a rule or tightens the budget
The brief, built in full: A sliding-ice puzzle: a penguin slides until it hits something; 24 hand-designed levels with keys, doors, crumbling tiles and a 3-star move target
6 designed levels with authored difficulty on depth, move-limit, board-complexity, piece-variety
Score and personal best, persisted locally
A rewarded placement at a natural moment in the loop (continue or bonus), never forced
Interstitials between sessions only, never inside one
Poki SDK: init, loading-progress, gameplay-start-stop, rewarded, interstitial, pause-audio-during-ads
out_of_scope: Multiplayer and any online play — networking multiplies the test surface and needs a server nobody has budgeted
Metagame layers: daily quests, battle pass, login rewards — retention systems are validated after the core loop is, not before
Character or skin customization and a cosmetics shop
Story, cutscenes and dialogue — text multiplies localization cost
A second mode or content set — one proves the loop; more is content, not validation
An IAP economy or premium currency
Platforms beyond the set: y8, gamedistribution — platform sprawl multiplies compliance work
prototype_must_prove: A first-time player understands the tap control without instruction
The core loop produces an unforced desire to retry within one 300-second session
This risk is contained: Poki requires web exclusivity, so the candidate platforms cannot all be used for the same build; choosing is a strategy decision
The rewarded placement reads as a favour rather than an interruption
It holds 30 fps on a mid-range mobile browser inside a 100 MB bundle

success_criteria.label: D1 retention
success_criteria.rationale: Below this a short-session title without a metagame has no path to sustained portal traffic.

success_criteria.label: Median session near target
success_criteria.rationale: Shorter than this and the placements the monetization model counts on never get a chance to show.

kill_criteria.label: First-time players do not understand the control
kill_criteria.rationale: The title is scoped around one control scheme and no tutorial. If that scheme needs teaching, the scope assumption is wrong.

kill_criteria.label: Players do not retry unprompted
kill_criteria.rationale: Replay is the retention system here, in place of content. Without immediate retry there is neither retention nor an ad moment.

kill_criteria.label: The prototype consumed most of the timebox
kill_criteria.rationale: A prototype that needs more than 60% of the timebox is evidence the scope does not fit it, and production would overrun by more.

kill_criteria.label: Unplayable on mid-range mobile
kill_criteria.rationale: Most portal traffic for this audience is mobile; below 30 fps a reaction-driven loop reads as the game's fault, not the player's.

concept.gameplay_direction: Logic built on A sliding-ice puzzle: a penguin slides until it hits something; 24 hand-designed levels with keys, doors, crumbling tiles and a 3-star move target. A session is a short run: read the level, plan the moves, solve it, advance to a harder level that adds a rule or tightens the budget. Content: 6 specified levels in the prototype, 20 in the release, difficulty authored per unit on depth, move-limit, board-complexity, piece-variety; progression linear-levels; level-authored ramp.
concept.replayability: Mastery ramp: short levels on one difficulty curve, each with a best result to improve on
